messages:
Dina (Acme): Hi team — we just did an org transfer and the console shows the trial/promo credits on the org page, but our service-key API calls return available_credits: 0 and usage is still being billed. Repro steps below.

Dina (Acme): curl -i -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk-acme-xxx\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/billing/credits

Dina (Acme): response: {\"available_credits\":0, \"applied_promos\":[]} — console shows 1,000 USD in org credits.

Aisha (Support): sorry about that — can you share the org_id and the service key id (only last 6 chars is ok)? also which region?

Dina (Acme): org_id: org-0a1b2c3d, service_key id last6: 7f9a2b. region: us-west-2. Happened right after we accepted the transfer and merged projects.

BillingBot: Automated alert: detected credit mapping mismatch for org org-0a1b2c3d; credits present at org-level but no active allocation to service keys. Ticket created: BLG-4621.

Ben (Eng): I can check the mapping. @Aisha can you grant me a temporary support token for read access to the billing mapping table?

Aisha (Support): Granted read token valid 30m. Also adding @Evan in case resync touches metering.

Ben (Eng): quick findings — during transfer, some org-level promos were attached to the old project id (proj-legacy-112). The service keys were remapped to new project id (proj-acme-900). The allocator didn’t run the allocation hook. I will run a targeted resync for org-0a1b2c3d and then a backfill for usage rows.

Ben (Eng): running: 
```
POST /internal/billing/resync
{ \"org_id\": \"org-0a1b2c3d\", \"force\": true }
```
Job queued: backfill-job-21122-99, estimated 10–20m.

Evan (SRE): FYI I verified no spike in write throughput. Backfill is low-priority batch; should not affect current writes.

Aisha (Support): Dina — we started the resync/backfill. I’ll follow up when it’s done. Sorry for the interruption.

Ben (Eng): backfill job status: RUNNING (0/3 shards complete). will post when complete.

(20m passes)

Ben (Eng): backfill job complete. Allocations updated: 1,000 USD applied to proj-acme-900 and linked service-keys. job-id: backfill-job-21122-99.

Aisha (Support): Dina can you re-run the curl and confirm?

Dina (Acme): re-ran curl: response now {\"available_credits\":1000000, \"applied_promos\":[\"promo-transfer-2026-03\"]} — looks good on our side. Can confirm new requests are billed against credits.

Dina (Acme): Thanks @Aisha @Ben @Evan and BillingBot :tada: — please let me know if you need anything else from our side.

Aisha (Support): marking BLG-4621 resolved, will keep monitoring for 24h and then close. If anything recurs, please reopen. :thumbsup:

Ben (Eng): noted root cause and mitigation steps in the ticket. adding a guard to run allocation hook as part of org-transfer flow to prevent recurrence.

BillingBot: BLG-4621 status -> RESOLVED (automated).
